variants.prompt: Amidst a neon-lit nightclub, the stunning woman with fiery locks and hazel eyes commands attention from the dance floor. Harsh, pulsing lights cast an otherworldly glow on her sun-kissed skin, while her fitted, high-necked top and form-fitting trousers seem to shimmer under the electric atmosphere. A bold, red lip and smoky eye define her expressive features as she loses herself in the rhythmic beats, her confident posture exuding a sense of unbridled desire.
